title: Tipping Terms for Wayfare Rides
content:
**Terms.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**:

1. A tip can be added only to a completed trip, as the trip's system record shows.
2. A tip may be added only within the tip window. The tip window is counted in calendar days in the market's local time: day 1 is the calendar day after the drop-off date, and the tip may be added through the end of the last day of the window. The length of the window is the ride option's tip window in calendar days, and the drop-off moment is taken from the trip record.
3. After the tip window has passed a tip can no longer be added through any channel.
4. One tip per trip, of any amount the rider chooses up to the ride option's largest single tip. Tips are paid in full to the driver, are not discounted or credited by Wayfare Pass, and are never refunded as a courtesy.
5. Adding a tip is the rider's own decision and is done by the rider.

## Counting the window

| Day | Calendar date (drop-off on a hypothetical 1 March, window of 30 days) |
|---|---|
| Drop-off date | 1 March — not counted |
| Day 1 | 2 March |
| Day 30, the last day | 31 March, through the end of the day in market local time |
| First day outside | 1 April |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, window of 30 days, drop-off 1 March)

- A tip on 31 March at 23:50 market local time is within the window — the last day counts in full.
- A tip on 1 April at 00:05 market local time is outside the window and cannot be added through any channel.
- A drop-off late in the evening of 1 March still makes 2 March day 1; the hour of drop-off does not shift the count, because the window counts calendar days from the drop-off date.

## Points of judgement

- A trip that was cancelled, marked a no-show or unfulfilled cannot take a tip.
- A trip that already carries a tip cannot take a second one.
